gates.reason: 'Propose, never apply' is a NEGATIVE guarantee about the judging session: the model must not edit the harness itself. The CLI has no verb that edits a hook, gate, script or doc — that much is structural — but whether the session following the skill edits files by hand is model behaviour no exit code can assert.

The CLI half is executable and pinned by tests/harness-retro-cli.test.mjs (an empty account and a format-drifted transcript both return measured:false with a named reason). The STATED gate is the reporting rule — the model must not relay an UNMEASURED scan as a clean result — which is a judgement about prose the session writes, not an exit code.

Enforced by code (checkProposalsAgainstScan in scripts/lib/friction/retro/proposal-schema.mjs; record exits 1) and pinned by tests/harness-retro-proposal-schema.test.mjs and tests/harness-retro-cli.test.mjs (inflated evidence refused from a second process). Not bound to a cli-exit scenario because `record` reads its envelope on stdin and the cli-exit recipe registry has no stdin channel; declared here rather than claimed as a binding that does not hold.
